BoreNav

by Aesir Creations
Planning aid only. Not an engineered design. Call 811, locate and pothole all utilities, and verify ground elevations in the field. Map elevations are approx. ±1.5–2 ft (USGS) or much worse (fallback) and are not survey grade.

Profile – pins

All bore paths together, each from its own entry (station 0). Tap a path to make it active.

As-built locked – read-only. The profile shows the locked plan and drilled shots; pins are disabled until the as-built is unlocked.

Plan sheet (PDF) values picked here are flagged IMPORTED-PDF and applied only after you confirm them

Text on this page

Works offline: the PDF viewer is built into this file and the PDF is kept on this device only. Vector PDFs give a text list you can tap; scanned or "text-as-lines" sheets can still be calibrated and traced by hand. Profile calibration uses two taps for stations and two for elevations, so vertical exaggeration is handled.

Import job (PDF / DXF)

Reads the plan & profile sheet from a vector PDF or ASCII DXF (R12–R2018) on this device – works offline. You review everything before it is applied.

3 · Rod table

After an edit:

Edit a rod's Pitch % or Depth and press Enter. Pitch: negative = going down. ΔPitch = deflection vs previous rod (percentage points). Flags: COMPUTED / MANUAL / AS-BUILT; ground USGS / OPEN-METEO / MANUAL / SCALED.

4 · Live as-built

Utility obstacles

Each utility is checked in the 2D bore profile only (lateral offset and crossing angle ignored). Keep-out = utility radius + buffer + reamer radius. Depth & cover routes over/under; Line and grade never moves the line, it reports PASS/FAIL and fixes. Planning aid only – call 811 and pothole every crossing.

Default buffer per type (saved on this device; blank = none)

5 · Settings & presets

Required depth to bore centerline = min cover + clearance + reamer radius. Cover in table = depth − reamer radius. Cover is enforced over the whole bore once the bit first reaches required depth (pit/ramp zones exempt), or between the cover-zone stations if set. Verify rod bend limits against the DD-110 rod spec.
